name: lua-virtualizer
description: Virtualize, obfuscate & protect Lua scripts with code virtualization, finite-state machine (FSM) transforms, weave tape, self-integrity checks, and anti-debugging.

luaVirtualizer.apiKey.markdownDescription: Enter your [activation code](https://www.pelock.com/products/lua-virtualizer/buy) (API key). Leave empty to run in **Demo mode** — only flat code virtualization is applied, other options are ignored, and scripts are limited to 1000 bytes.

luaVirtualizer.enableCompression.markdownDescription: Compress source code before sending it to the Web API (recommended for large scripts). Both the request and the virtualized response are compressed.

luaVirtualizer.seed.markdownDescription: Optional fixed random seed for reproducible virtualization. `0` leaves the seed unset (a new seed each run).

luaVirtualizer.randomizationDensity.markdownDescription: Randomization density / intensity (`0`–`100`). Higher values apply more of each probabilistic transform.

luaVirtualizer.target.markdownDescription:
**Dialect**

Automatic tries the source as 5.1, then 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5, then Luau, and keeps the oldest dialect that parses. LuaJIT is not inferred. A script whose only newer feature is goto is detected as 5.2, because goto arrived in Lua 5.2. Choose LuaJIT explicitly when the script must be treated as LuaJIT.

luaVirtualizer.codeVirtualizationEnabled.markdownDescription:
**Code virtualization**

Enable the selected virtualization mode. Uncheck to emit ordinary Lua while keeping the last mode saved.

luaVirtualizer.codeVirtualization.markdownDescription: Virtualization mode applied when **Code virtualization** is enabled: `vm`, `fsm`, `weave`, `flat`, or `rnd`. `rnd` picks VM, FSM, or WEAVE for that run. FLAT is not in the draw.

luaVirtualizer.renameStyle.markdownDescription: Rename style used by the rename strategies: `il` (Il1…), `o0` (O0o…), `hex`, or `mangled`.

luaVirtualizer.selfDefending.markdownDescription:
**Protection against tampering with protected code (integrity verification)**

Final anti-tamper pass inserts an integrity probe that fingerprints the loaded chunk. Decrypt and trip keys are derived from that live token — edits poison later transforms (garbage instead of plaintext). Optional re-verify hashes the same chunk again. The probe does not need a separate copy of the script on disk.

luaVirtualizer.protectionLinker.markdownDescription:
**Protection linker (decoy call graph, requires self-defending)**

Late pass linking protected helpers: honeypot resolvers, bogus calls with random args, and shallow-stack tripwires active only before bootstrap. Normal runs unchanged; extracted snippets stay noisy.

luaVirtualizer.renameVariables.markdownDescription:
**Rename variables**

Local and global variables become random identifiers; every reference updates together. Scope rules preserved.

luaVirtualizer.renameParameters.markdownDescription:
**Rename parameters**

Parameter names and in-body bindings rewritten to opaque tokens.

luaVirtualizer.renameFunctions.markdownDescription:
**Rename functions**

Function definitions renamed and calls retargeted; metamethods such as `__index` and built-in library functions stay untouched.

luaVirtualizer.renameFunctionCalls.markdownDescription:
**Retarget function calls through an indirect name table**

Direct call sites are rewritten to look up the target through a name/dispatch table instead of the literal identifier.

luaVirtualizer.shuffleFunctions.markdownDescription:
**Shuffle function order**

Permutes top-level function definitions when execution order still remains valid.

luaVirtualizer.resolveConstants.markdownDescription:
**Resolve and inline named constants**

Module-level constant assignments are inlined at every use site and unused declarations removed.

luaVirtualizer.splitStrings.markdownDescription:
**Split strings into concatenated chunks**

Literals split and joined at runtime — whole tokens no longer appear in one place.

luaVirtualizer.modifyStrings.markdownDescription:
**Modify strings with runtime character transforms**

Literals are rewritten as shifted characters rebuilt with a small runtime transform.

luaVirtualizer.encryptStrings.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt strings using randomly generated polymorphic encryption algorithms**

Each run emits a unique per-string decryptor with randomly chosen bitwise loops — no two outputs share the same algorithm shape.

luaVirtualizer.stringCharArrayVault.markdownDescription:
**Char-code array vault**

Strings rebuilt from numeric char codes instead of quoted text.

luaVirtualizer.encryptIntegers.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt integers**

Plain integers become equivalent arithmetic or bitwise expressions.

luaVirtualizer.encryptFloating.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt floating point numbers**

Rewrites floating-point literals into equivalent `math` expressions, so constants are no longer visible as plain numeric values.

luaVirtualizer.integersToFloating.markdownDescription:
**Integers via floating-point math**

Whole numbers reconstructed from `math` library float expressions and cast back with `math.floor`.

luaVirtualizer.integersToArrays.markdownDescription:
**Move integers to arrays**

Values stored in tables and read by index alongside decoy entries.

luaVirtualizer.floatsToArrays.markdownDescription:
**Move floats to arrays**

Floats lifted into table slots with decoy values mixed in.

luaVirtualizer.affineIntegerMask.markdownDescription:
**Redundant xor / affine masks**

Reversible bit masks wrap integers without changing the result. The helper matches the selected dialect.

luaVirtualizer.mbaBinops.markdownDescription:
**Mixed boolean-arithmetic (MBA) operator rewriting**

Binary operators are replaced with equivalent mixed boolean-arithmetic identities, hiding the original operator from static pattern matching.

luaVirtualizer.arrayIntCrypt.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt literal integer list contents**

Integer table contents are stored in encrypted form and decoded at runtime before use.

luaVirtualizer.arrayCharCrypt.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt literal char list contents**

Character table literals are replaced with encrypted values and restored only through generated decoder code.

luaVirtualizer.arrayDoubleCrypt.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt literal float list contents**

Float table constants are hidden as encoded bit patterns and reconstructed while the program runs.

luaVirtualizer.arrayStringCrypt.markdownDescription:
**Encrypt literal string list contents**

String table elements are encrypted independently and rebuilt on demand by generated runtime code.

luaVirtualizer.insertRandomValueBucket.markdownDescription:
**Insert module-level decoy value pools**

Enables the module-level noise pools controlled by the sub-options below.

luaVirtualizer.randomBucketIntegers.markdownDescription:
**Decoy integer pool entries**

Unused integer decoys added to the pool.

luaVirtualizer.randomBucketArrays.markdownDescription:
**Decoy array pool entries**

Unused table decoys added to the pool.

luaVirtualizer.randomBucketFunctions.markdownDescription:
**Decoy function pool entries**

Unused decoy functions added to the pool.

luaVirtualizer.randomBucketCharacters.markdownDescription:
**Decoy character pool entries**

Unused character decoys added to the pool.

luaVirtualizer.randomBucketAntiRegex.markdownDescription:
**Decoy anti-regex noise entries**

Regex-shaped decoy literals designed to distract naive static-signature scanners.

luaVirtualizer.randomBucketAutostart.markdownDescription:
**Decoy autostart noise entries**

Decoy string literals resembling autostart/persistence paths, never referenced by live code.

luaVirtualizer.insertTernaryOperators.markdownDescription:
**Insert ternary operators**

Simple branches collapse into conditional expressions, blending assignment logic into a single opaque line.

luaVirtualizer.complexifyBooleans.markdownDescription:
**Complexify boolean conditions**

Simple true/false tests rewritten into longer equivalent conditions.

luaVirtualizer.opaqueBranches.markdownDescription:
**Opaque predicate branches**

Always-false branches that look like real control flow — increases graph complexity.

luaVirtualizer.opaqueMixerChain.markdownDescription:
**Opaque mixer chains and unreachable guards**

Adds static mixer functions, invokes chains of them inside functions, and emits guards that should never execute, increasing the amount of code a reader has to analyze.

luaVirtualizer.insertDeadCode.markdownDescription:
**Dead code insertion**

Statements under opaque never-true conditions — pads output without changing results.

luaVirtualizer.tryFinallyNoise.markdownDescription:
**Try/finally noise**

Lua has no try/finally, so the pass emits an inert `pcall` plus cleanup. The extra nesting does not change values.

luaVirtualizer.decoyFunctions.markdownDescription:
**Decoy functions**

Plausible-looking functions that are never called — noise for reverse engineers.

luaVirtualizer.lambdaDecoys.markdownDescription:
**Anonymous-function decoys**

Unused anonymous function bindings near the top — never called at runtime.

luaVirtualizer.literalPadding.markdownDescription:
**Literal string padding**

Bulky string constant shifts line numbers and inflates file size — never read by live logic.

luaVirtualizer.fakeImportMarkers.markdownDescription:
**Fake require comment markers**

Comment lines mimic extra `require` dependencies. Removed when **Strip comments** is on.

luaVirtualizer.dynamicGetattrCalls.markdownDescription:
**Dynamic table-lookup call indirection**

Call targets are built from fragments and resolved through a table lookup, so a static search for the function name fails.

luaVirtualizer.obfuscateImports.markdownDescription:
**Obfuscate require calls**

Rewrites `require` so the module name is built at runtime. The module-name strings remain available for later string encryption.

luaVirtualizer.callbackRegistrationStubs.markdownDescription:
**Dead callback/handler registration stubs**

Snippets resemble callback/handler registration setup but never wire a real event source.

luaVirtualizer.detectDebugger.markdownDescription:
**Insert anti-debugging detections**

Detect debuggers, virtual machines, sandboxed environments, CPU emulators.

Detect debuggers attached to the process (`debug.gethook()`; Windows `IsDebuggerPresent`).

The added code runs at the beginning of the script. A positive detection silently terminates the process, without an error message.

luaVirtualizer.antiSandbox.markdownDescription:
**Insert anti-sandbox detections**

Detect debuggers, virtual machines, sandboxed environments, CPU emulators.

- Check for an abnormally low number of CPU cores (exit if fewer than 3)
- Sandboxie (DLL libraries `SbieDll` / `SbieHide`, registry)
- Joe Sandbox (processes)
- Analysis host / user / path / env tokens (Cuckoo and similar)

The added code runs at the beginning of the script. A positive detection silently terminates the process, without an error message.

luaVirtualizer.antiVm.markdownDescription:
**Insert virtual machine (anti-VM) detections**

Detect debuggers, virtual machines, sandboxed environments, CPU emulators.

- VMware (processes, files, drivers, BIOS registry, MAC OUI, platform strings)
- Oracle VirtualBox (processes, files, drivers, BIOS registry)
- Parallels (processes, files)
- KVM (drivers)
- Linux DMI product/vendor strings when not on Windows

The added code runs at the beginning of the script. A positive detection silently terminates the process, without an error message.

luaVirtualizer.antiEmulator.markdownDescription:
**Insert anti-emulators (CPU) detections**

Detect debuggers, virtual machines, sandboxed environments, CPU emulators.

- WINE (API inconsistencies, DLL libraries, special API functions)
- Bochs / QEMU (processes, BIOS registry)
- XEN (processes)
- CPU/user-mode emulator markers and a short timing self-check

The added code runs at the beginning of the script. A positive detection silently terminates the process, without an error message.

luaVirtualizer.removeComments.markdownDescription:
**Strip comments**

Comments (`--`) removed from the emitted script.
